name: anyone-can-code
description: Front-door Codex workflow router with local state, portable Markdown memory, optional hooks, and evidence-first verification.

interface.shortDescription: Front door for ideas, repos, bugs, reviews, setup, memory, and verification workflows.
interface.longDescription: Anyone Can Code routes vague ideas, existing repos, feature requests, bugs, reviews, setup, learning, status, resume, and ship requests into explicit Codex workflows. It stores project-owned state and artifacts under .codex/anyone-can-code, uses portable Markdown memory with tiny fallback ledgers, supports optional bundled or repo-local hooks, keeps routing in the orchestrator, and separates implemented work from verified evidence.
defaultPrompt: I want to build something, but I may be starting from an idea, a repo, or a bug.
Resume my last workflow and tell me the next best step.
Verify what changed and tell me what is still uncertain.
